findings.owner: the characteristic front/rear facade carries thick real 3D frame/beam-like solids that the model under-models
findings.sources: 138 linear members carry a depth cue (front 4, rear 4, side 72, renders 58); 67 further bands carry none and are recorded as surface regions
findings.model: the reference model carries the same facade zones as SURFACE_REGIONs — finish assignments on a flat wall — and no solid linear member anywhere on the front or rear
findings.note: this is the owner’s finding, recovered from the images rather than asserted: each member names the cue that promoted it, and the bands that carry only a change of tone are kept apart from those that do not

findings.owner: the major facade frame appears to continue from the garage zone toward/under the balcony and along facade edges
findings.sources: the front elevation’s longest member spans most of the facade width and CONTINUES_ACROSS relations link horizontal members to the vertical ones they meet
findings.model: the reference model has no element that runs across the garage/house junction: the zones are separate finish regions on separate walls
findings.note: a CONTINUES_ACROSS relation is what lets a later solver recover ONE member turning a corner instead of two unrelated lumps

findings.sources: 18 recess mouths found; 0 side returns found closing them; every side with no return found is recorded as a named gap
findings.model: the reference model’s loggia is a recess in the wall with no modelled return walls
findings.note: a recess with no side returns is a hole in a wall rather than a room, which is exactly what the preview showed

findings.owner: the staircase topology/orientation does not match the published plan closely enough
findings.sources: NO tread run on any published plan could be held to be a staircase: 5 regular run(s) of strokes were considered and each was rejected with its reason. The section yields 1 stepped chain(s)
findings.model: the reference model asserts a 4-riser flight, 4 winders and a 9-riser flight (17 risers at 0.18 m)
findings.note: the published plans are 853 px for a 12 m house, so a 0.27 m going is about 9 px and a fill pattern is 4 px. At that separation a hatch and a flight are not distinguishable, and a stair invented from a planting symbol cannot be undone downstream. The model’s stair is therefore an assertion the current sources do not corroborate — which is the finding, not a defect in it

findings.owner: not raised; checked because it is the one angle the model claims to have measured
findings.sources: 36 roof edges measured in image space, closest to the model within 0.04 degrees
findings.model: the reference model uses a 40 degree pitch from the section’s printed annotation
findings.note: an image-space angle is a true pitch only on a drawing with the same scale in both axes; this corroborates rather than measures
